name: Sales Agent
description: Primary outbound B2B security sales workflow.
prompt_instruction: Drive a focused discovery call around cloud posture, alert fatigue, compliance pressure, and demo interest.

name: Lead Qualification Agent
description: Quick qualification workflow for inbound cybersecurity leads.
prompt_instruction: Verify company fit, team size, cloud footprint, and whether the lead is a decision-maker or evaluator.

name: Follow-up Agent
description: Follow-up workflow for demo no-shows, stalled deals, and nurture calls.
prompt_instruction: Reference prior context naturally, uncover blockers, and secure a concrete next step with the prospect.
